p2-d17-b6.actual: FIXED by Fixer 2026-09-16. server/src/index.ts's top-level error middleware (~lines 292-309) now branches on e?.type === "entity.parse.failed" || e?.status === 400 and returns a clean 400 {"error":"That request wasn't valid — please try again."} instead of falling through to the generic 500. Re-verified live with malformed JSON POST ("{\"bad json") against all three routes QA tested: /api/bookings → 400, /api/customers → 400, /api/tasks → 400 (all previously 500). entity.too.large still returns 413 as before (branch order preserved, not regressed).
p2-d17-b6.notes: One shared fix in the top-level error middleware covers every /api/* route, as QA noted. server tsc --noEmit clean for index.ts (one unrelated pre-existing error in server/src/routes/leave.ts:131, not touched by this fix, not introduced by it).
p2-d17-b6.evidence: server/src/index.ts:292-309 (fix); verified via curl -X POST with malformed JSON body against /api/bookings, /api/customers, /api/tasks (all 400 after fix, were 500 before)

p2-d17-b10.actual: GET /api/bookings?limit=-1 → 200 (returns the tenant's normal list, 0 rows in this fresh tenant); GET /api/bookings?limit=999999999 → 200 (same)
p2-d17-b10.notes: Neither call errors or crashes, but bookings.ts's list route doesn't read a `limit` query param at all (confirmed by grep) — both requests silently ignore the parameter and just return the tenant's full list rather than erroring or applying any cap. Not a crash/security bug on its own (this tenant's list is naturally small), but flagged as a genuine gap: no page-size limit exists on this list route at all, which plan2's own intent doc already calls out as a class of thing never swept (pagination).
